No front door

Followers stay followers

Someone can watch your videos for a year and never give you an email address. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Your calendar does the filtering

With an open booking link, the sorting happens on the call itself. Time goes to people who were curious, not ready, and the ready ones wait in the same queue.

Content treadmill

5,545 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next video. When you take a week off, the bookings take a week off too.

The people who love your content but aren't ready for 1:1 today have nothing to buy from you, so most of them buy nothing.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your 1:1 sessions

You have the audience and the message. What's missing is one low-cost class that teaches your approach to self-respect, offers a simple add-on straight after checkout, and invites the right people to apply for 1:1. Meta ads then put that class in front of new people every day.

Fixes the missing front door

One $17 class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own, and every one of them has already said yes to you once.

The replay page invites people who want to go deeper to apply. Your calendar only sees people who paid, watched, stayed and told you what's going on.

Pays for the ads

Seat sales and the add-on bring in revenue on the front end, which goes straight back into the ad spend. Your 1:1 sessions become the profit, not the thing that funds the marketing.

Sound familiar?

You keep everyone else comfortable. And you pay for it.

  • You're tired of over-giving and saying yes when you mean no, just to keep other people comfortable.
  • You over-explain every decision, as if you need permission to make it.
  • When you do set a boundary, the guilt shows up straight after.
  • The small daily ways you put yourself last are teaching people how to treat you.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

Self-respect vs self-esteem

Why feeling good about yourself isn't the same as acting like you matter, and why the second one changes everything.

02

The quiet ways we abandon ourselves

The small daily habits that teach people how to treat you, and how to spot them in yourself.

03

Boundaries without the guilt

What to actually say when you need to say no, and how to hold the line without turning it into a fight.

04

Relationships that match your standards

How raising your own standards changes who stays, who leaves, and who shows up next.

05

Your next step

A simple 30-day practice to keep going, and how 1:1 work with Jared looks if you want to go deeper.

Static 3 · Contrast layout · Hook: the automatic yes

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Self-respect isn't a feeling"

Hook
"Most people are waiting to feel confident before they act like they matter. That's backwards." (to camera, same setting and look as your profile)
Body
"Self-respect isn't a mood you wait for. It's what you do in the small moments: the yes you don't give, the text you don't send, the standard you keep when nobody's watching. Do those enough and the feeling follows." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach the whole practice in a live 60-minute class called The Radical Self-Respect Masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you say yes"

Hook
"Before you say yes to anyone, ask yourself these three questions." (Jared holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: do I actually want to do this? Two: am I saying yes out of choice or out of fear of what they'll think? Three: what am I saying no to by saying yes? If the answers make you wince, you already know what to do." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go through the full approach, and the exact words to use, in my live masterclass. Link below. $17 a seat."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me whether they should start with my videos or book a 1:1. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, start with the masterclass. In one hour you'll learn how I think about self-respect, try the practice that week, and know whether you want to go deeper with me."
CTA
"It's called The Radical Self-Respect Masterclass, it's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
